reviews.title: Always Call failed and no support is found
reviews.body:
Title: Frequent call failures and disappointing customer service

I’ve been experiencing frequent call failures with Lebara, which has become extremely frustrating and inconvenient.

I contacted customer service through live chat for help, but after waiting nearly 30 minutes, I still received no response.

It’s very disappointing to experience ongoing problems with such an essential service and then be unable to get help from customer support.

I expect better reliability and customer service from a mobile network provider. I hope Lebara takes these issues seriously and improves both its call service and customer support.
I don’t have a reference number because the customer service didn’t reply me anymore

reviews.title: I was told that Lebara would provide a…
reviews.body:
I was told that Lebara would provide a Deadlock Letter. I asked for it by 8 October, but I have not received it.

Given their commitment to provide the letter and the deadline I set, I believe this delay is an attempt to obstruct the Ombudsman’s investigation and is wilfully uncooperative.

I escalated complaint because of Lebara’a handling of my complaint following being a victim of fraud and them subsequently barring my service and refusing to restore it on top of many communication attempts they ignore.

Instead of providing the letter, Lebara has asked me to delete my reviews. This makes me feel that managing its public reputation is being prioritised over cooperating and their customers. I will not be deleting my reviews and I will continue to post daily updates until you comply.

Avoid this provider at all costs! Once my issues are resolved I will be switching!
